info.title: UserService API
info.description: User Service API for authentication, user profiles, and image management in the ECommerce system.

post.summary: Registers a new user account with default customer role.

400.description: Validation failure or email already in use.

post.summary: Authenticates user credentials and generates a JWT access token.

get.summary: Retrieves the current authenticated user's profile details.

put.summary: Updates the current authenticated user's profile details (first name, last name, phone).

400.description: Validation error or invalid input data.

post.summary: Uploads an avatar image for the current authenticated user.

400.description: No file uploaded, invalid file format, or validation failure.

delete.summary: Deletes the avatar image for the current authenticated user.

400.description: Operation failure or image could not be deleted.

token.description: JWT bearer access token for authorized requests.

expiresAt.description: Expiration timestamp of the access token in UTC.

AuthResponse.description: Response returned upon successful user authentication or registration.

LoginRequest.description: Request payload for authenticating a user.

email.description: User's email address (used as unique login credential).

RegisterRequest.description: Request payload for registering a new user account.

UpdateUserProfileDto.description: Request payload for updating the current user's profile details.

profileImageUrl.description: Public URL or relative path to the profile avatar image.

UserProfileDto.description: User profile details returned for authenticated profile queries.

UserResponse.description: User identity summary returned in authentication responses.

Bearer.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme. Enter your JWT token directly.
